scope: Every operation is conditional on explicit model, observation, target and sampling declarations. Candidates are source-qualified, not runtime-qualified.

operations.input: Single-decision view, finite categorical action, baseline adjustment set, target population and weight roles
operations.identification: Consistency, exchangeability, no interference within the declared unit model, and target support; adjustment derivation
operations.estimation: Cross-fitted augmented mean or qualified targeted update
operations.inference: Declared independent-unit or qualified cluster score expansion, positivity and nuisance-product remainder

operations.input: Assignment, receipt, outcome, controls, instrument timing and target stratum
operations.target: ITT, specified homogeneous structural coefficient or specified complier weighted effect
operations.identification: Assignment exogeneity and support; receipt target additionally requires exclusion and relevance plus homogeneity or monotone compliance
operations.estimation: Declared residual IV moment, 2SLS/GMM or compliance ratio
operations.inference: Strong-rank moment sandwich or qualified weak-IV test inversion; retain unbounded/disconnected sets
unsupported_or_failure: ATE requested from unrestricted IV graph
weak denominator with ordinary normal interval
acceptance: same observed IV law with different ATE

operations.input: Entity/calendar view, first-adoption cohort, comparison group, anticipation window and aggregation weights
operations.target: Group-time ATT with declared aggregation; linear panel moments are separate targets
operations.identification: Named parallel-trend, overlap and anticipation restrictions
operations.estimation: Qualified group-time contrasts with influence contributions
operations.inference: Cohort/assignment-unit resampling or qualified influence construction, simultaneous bands if requested
unsupported_or_failure: reversible action encoded as first adoption

operations.input: Finite-horizon trajectories, ordered histories, eligibility, event/censoring roles and policy density
operations.target: Fixed-policy value or a separately registered propensity-dependent intervention functional
operations.identification: Sequential exchangeability, consistency and policy-specific support; censoring assumptions only for the specified outcome
operations.estimation: Backward continuation, cumulative ratios, augmented or targeted recursion matching the policy functional
operations.inference: Trajectory gradient with fixed-horizon remainder and qualified sampling experiment; frozen-policy evaluation separated from policy learning

operations.input: Series vintages, observation frequency, shock/instrument, impact normalization, controls, fixed horizons and dependence design
operations.identification: Declared contemporaneous and dynamic exclusions or explicit structural restrictions
operations.estimation: Qualified local-projection IV or separately justified structural propagation
operations.inference: Stacked score covariance, qualified HAC or source-specific alternative; weak-normalization sets where needed

operations.input: Initial/transition/emission/reward/logger laws, observation timing, policy information and identification route
operations.target: Model-conditional likelihood/filter, target-specific identified value or value ambiguity
operations.identification: Known-emission randomized route or explicitly supplied structural/proxy restrictions; no general unknown-emission causal guarantee
operations.estimation: Qualified forward/backward likelihood and EM/posterior approximation; planning consumes the interventional law
operations.inference: Parameter uncertainty, model ambiguity and numerical error retained separately; fixed-policy bootstrap is not selected optimal-policy inference

operations.input: Graph class, variables, clock/window, background constraints, observation and CI/functional-model restrictions
operations.target: Equivalence graph followed by a common functional, effect set or unresolved query
operations.identification: Graph-class-specific discovery plus separately justified adjustment/identification over compatible causal models
operations.estimation: Endpoint-preserving discovery and bounded generalized adjustment or small-class enumeration
operations.inference: Graph selection uncertainty and effect uncertainty separated; stability frequency is not an arrow probability
